key_rationale: With headline CPI at 5.02% and the repo rate at 6.50%, the real policy rate is approaching a neutral level of 1%, which is appropriate given the current growth-inflation balance. While food inflation at 6.56% requires monitoring, the supply-side nature of these shocks suggests that maintaining the current stance is prudent to anchor expectations without stifling the robust 7.60% GVA growth.
